name: Vaneform
tagline: Vaneform is a free website traffic checker: look up any site's monthly visits, traffic sources and top countries.
description: Vaneform is a free website traffic checker for founders, marketers and researchers. Enter any public domain to see estimated monthly visits, the monthly trend, the traffic-source mix and country shares, then compare several sites side by side. Discovery boards rank growing websites, disclosed revenue and AI referral traffic. Keyword demand, ranking keywords, domain registration and website history sit next to the traffic report. A REST API and an open-source MCP server bring the same data into scripts and AI assistants. Each estimate keeps its source, date and confidence. Website lookup is free (guests get 3 lookups a day; a signed-in Free account gets 20 a day and 100 API credits a month). Pro adds unlimited lookups, keyword data and full leaderboards; the official pricing page currently shows Pro at $99 a year when billed annually ($8.25 a month). Vaneform is built by Kai, an independent developer, and is available in English and Chinese. Traffic figures are third-party estimates, not a guarantee of actual visits, rankings or business results.
